note: Denmark: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list; Nordic citizens are among them). Everyone else working in Denmark needs a work permit from the Danish Agency for International Recruitment and Integration (SIRI). Artists, musicians and performers who are the focal point or of major significance for a significant public artistic event of a short-term character (normally under 14 days) are exempt: not modelled as an exemption open to a performer generally.

sources.title: New to Denmark (SIRI), Exemption from the requirement of a work permit
sources.said: As a rule, a foreign national, who will be working in Denmark, must have a work permit. However, artists, musicians, performers, etc. and associated staff can be exempted from the requirement of a work permit, if they are of importance for a significant artistic event. The artist, musician, performer etc. must, as a rule, be the focal point or main attraction of the event, or at least be of major significance for the artistic event. ... The event must have a short-term character, normally with a duration of less than 14 days.
